# BackedSure

BackedSure helps South African professionals and professional-service businesses understand, apply for, and manage Professional Indemnity insurance.

## What BackedSure Covers

- Professional Indemnity insurance for advice, errors, omissions, negligence, and professional-service liability.
- Cyber Liability for data breaches, ransomware, and network security failures.
- Directors & Officers Liability for directors and officers facing management liability claims.
- Fidelity Guarantee for employee theft, fraud, and dishonesty.
- Commercial Crime for broader crime exposures.
- Public Liability for third-party bodily injury or property damage.

## Main User Tasks

- Select a profession.
- Complete a quote application.
- Understand PI cover, exclusions, pricing factors, retroactive dates, run-off cover, and claims-made policy mechanics.
- Notify a claim or circumstance.
- Browse resources and profession-specific insurance guidance.
